tasks.short: Record agricultural research and animal-care data faithfully

steps.what: Record primary observations for experimentation, research or animal care
Transfer recorded data into the consolidated research or care record
Check recorded data against source observations and resolve discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure validated forms and native imports in research-record {OTHER} before custom integration. The technician captures observations once; fixed mappings move the captured fields into the consolidated record, and source checking remains human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Primary entries are copied into a second record or workbook.
tasks.enabler_now: Electronic data-capture forms provide field logic and an audit trail.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying the correct specimen, animal or experimental unit and describing unusual observations.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that a plausible value belongs to the wrong experimental context.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated entry, with responsibility for source fidelity retained.

evidence.claim: Castor EDC provides conditional forms and audit trails; agricultural workflow fit and labour savings still require testing.
The proposed duplicate-transfer saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is recording and consolidating observations, excluding experiment execution, specimen examination and animal-care treatment allocated separately.

Technician captures study or care identifier, animal/specimen/plot identifier, observation time, variable identifier, raw value or factual narrative, unit, missingness, instrument reference and author in s1's 55 hours. Instrument-generated values include instrument identifier, timestamp and quality from the instrument at measurement. Missing metadata or handwritten entries remain manual capture in s1; transfer exceptions are corrected in s3.
OTHER means research electronic data capture or laboratory record software. Native forms and imports are tested before custom code. Existing automated recording runtime receives no new saving.
The 20-hour transfer share applies only where duplicate entry exists today; already consolidated records have zero transfer saving. No judgement or disease code is inferred.
unknowns: Required record system and instrument metadata availability
research_questions: Does native consolidation remove repeated entry after capture and source checking?

already_counted.description: Check source fidelity and resolve unit, identifier and transfer discrepancies

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings, identifier lists and changed-protocol tests

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+0+25=80, gross=20, upkeep=5, net=15. Range 0-8 allows existing direct capture and frequent unstructured observations.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine animals and crop specimens for problems

steps.what: Examine animals or crop specimens for diseases and other problems

tasks.design: Retain physical examination and contextual assessment with the technician. Relevant history in {DOCS} can support the examination, but no validated diagnosis from images or structured symptoms is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The meaningful signs depend on the specimen, conditions and examination method.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated capability in the digest removes this examination effort.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing disease from environmental stress, injury or normal variation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertainty and seek the appropriate specialist assessment.

evidence.claim: Physical animal and crop examination remains human; no applicable task-level saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is examination and initial assessment, excluding formal data recording, laboratory tests and treatment decisions allocated separately.
No machine-produced disease status, structured healthy flag or automated treatment decision is introduced.
Existing native access to history may continue without a new system or runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is proposed.
unknowns: Species, crop types and examination scope
research_questions: Is source-history retrieval a separate measurable burden distinct from physical examination?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Physical examination and assessment remain human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Train agricultural technicians or farm laborers through demonstrated practice and feedback
Supervise agricultural work and resolve procedural or practical questions

tasks.design: Keep hands-on training and supervision with the experienced technician, supported by procedures in {DOCS}. Demonstration, observation of practice and situational correction retain their time; no employee scoring or automatic competence judgement is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Understanding a procedure is different from performing it reliably in field conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated technical change removes direct coaching or supervisory judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising mistakes before they compromise welfare, safety or an experiment.
tasks.human_edge: Give immediate, specific feedback matched to the person's understanding.
tasks.altitude: The technician retains direct coaching and supervisory responsibility.

reach.learn: Adult learning and practical competence feedback

evidence.claim: Direct agricultural coaching and supervision remain human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is direct training and supervision, excluding training-material production, scheduling and record administration not established by the task.
No inferred staff competence field or automatic task allocation is introduced. Trainee and staff effort remains unchanged outside focal savings.
Native access to procedures continues without new configuration or runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is proposed.
research_questions: Is there a separately measured preparation task that native procedure reuse could reduce?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50+50=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Direct coaching and supervision remain human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct fertilizer studies that test crop and environmental outcomes

steps.what: Plan fertilizer application studies with appropriate comparisons and environmental measures
Conduct fertilizer studies and evaluate crop needs, leaching and runoff evidence

tasks.design: Keep trial planning, conduct and interpretation with the technician under scientific guidance, using {DOCS} for the protocol. Fertilisation maps can support an authorised trial but do not replace evidence about crop response and environmental loss at this site.
tasks.previous_blocker: A fertilizer strategy depends on crop, soil, weather and local validation.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated tool removes the specified experimental work.
tasks.still_hard: Measuring benefits and losses without mistaking a site-specific response for a general rule.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise confounding conditions and limits on transferring a result.

reach.learn: Trial design, nutrient cycling and confounding

evidence.claim: Farmmaps provides fertilisation task maps and variable-rate zoning; it does not establish reduced labour for conducting these studies.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive study planning, experimental conduct and interpretation. Formal observation-record transfer is allocated to the separate data-recording task and receives no duplicate saving here.
No machine-selected dose, inferred crop-need flag or automatic trial conclusion is introduced. Existing approved application and measurement procedures continue.
Native mapping and analysis tools are considered before custom software, but current runtime earns no labour-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because no study workflow change is proposed.
research_questions: Is a separate repeatable calculation burden measurable without reducing fieldwork or validation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+60=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Trial conduct and scientific assessment retain their human time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Selected duplicate record transfer can disappear while examination, coaching and experimental judgement remain human.
role.ambitious_version: A technician who records evidence reliably with less duplicate entry and keeps attention on organisms, field conditions and valid experiments.
